tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version numbering scheme

The project's current recorded decision is to use Semantic Versioning (semver) for release numbering: the major version signals breaking changes, the minor version signals backward-compatible new features, and the patch version signals backward-compatible bug fixes. The stated rationale is that this lets users judge the safety of an update from the version number alone, without reading release notes.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
